checks.pin_ties: RESULT: all sixteen tied to VGND | no two other pins share a net
hvi: HVI to low-voltage n-well: smallest >= 0.70 um (limit 0.64), 0 places below 0.64, 0 below 0.70: ok
HVI width: 0 places narrower than 0.84 um (narrowest bounding-box side 0.84): ok
HVI edges across gate poly: 197 (121 poly shapes; limit 197, lock2's): ok
capm.10: 105 of 109 MIM capacitors with a lower layer's edge under them (limit 105, lock4_r's): ok
licon.15: npc around poly contacts at least 0.105 um, 0 outside npc (limit 0.10): ok
checks.contact_bars: RESULT: PASS | 1454 bars, 53670 squares, 0 other licon shapes | 0 bar pairs and 0 bar-square pairs too close after mask growth | planted faults: 8 of 8 found as planted, 4 patterns at the limit pass
checks.resistor_length: RESULT: PASS | 374 resistor bodies, 0 shorter than 0.66 um along the current or not measurable | shortest 0.7 um | planted faults: 4 of 4 found at their planted length, 2 of 2 at the limit pass
checks.well_rules_direct: RESULT: PASS | lvtn across a well's edge 0, lvtn enclosure under 0.38 0, hvtp AND n-well under 0.38 wide 0 or apart 0, hvtp outside a well beyond the standard cells' own strips 0, urpm over a well 0, urpm under 0.70 from a well 0 | planted faults: 6 of 6 found, 2 patterns at the limit pass
checks.resistors_near_nmos: RESULT: PASS | 66 precision-resistor markers | marker to NMOS gate poly 0.69, to nsdm 0.275; resistor poly to NMOS gate poly 0.89; contacts to NMOS gate poly 0.97, to nsdm 0.555 um | none below lock4_r's | planted faults: 2 of 2 found, 1 at the limit pass
